Class SysMLAttributeType

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute
Direct Known Subclasses:
BBoolean, Complex, ElectricalPower, HexahedronMeters, IInteger, InternetAddress, KeyValueMap, ListOrdered, NeuralNetDisplayData, NeuralNetDisplayDefinition, NeuralNetInputDataSet, NeuralNetOutputDataSet, Point2D, Point3D, PointGeospatial, Polyline2D, PolylineGeospatial, PrivateKey, PublicKey, QueueFIFO, Rectangle2D, RectangleGeospatial, RectangleMeters, RReal, SString, SysMLEnumeration, SysMLProbabilityDistribution
public abstract class SysMLAttributeType extends SysMLAnything implements ObservableAttribute
SysMLinJava's representation of the SysML attribute type. The SysMLAttributeType is an abstract class that serves as the base class for specialized attribute types. It extends the SysMLAnything with a SysMLUnit, a SysMLProbabilityDistribution (as prescribed by SysML), and the functions of an ObservableAttribute. The SysMLinJava implementation of the ObservableAttribute interface by the SysMLAttributeType makes the attribute "observable", i.e. it can notify (call) associated AttributeObserver objects if/when the value of the SysMLAttributeType changes. This abstract class essentially is the SysMLinJava application of the "Observable/Observer" pattern to achieve the binding connector that is used by the analysis case, ports, parts, etc. to bind to attributes. This feature of the SysMLAttributeType can also be used for other operations in which the "Observable/Observer" pattern might be needed.

Note that the SysML specification calls for inclusion of SysML's quantityKind in the properties of the attribute type. It also calls for the inclusion of the SysML unit in the attribute type as well. Since the unit contains the quantityKind, the SysMLinJava implementation does not include the quantityKind in the attribute type so as to prevent duplication of information.

    • observers

      public List<AttributeObserver> observers
      List of AttributeObservers to be notified if/when this SysMLAttributeType instance's value changes. Note that extension classes of the SysMLAttributeType that need to use the ObservableAttribute interface and this list of AttributeObservers must implement a "setValue(<value>) operation that, in addition to setting the attribute's value, also invokes the notifyAttributeObservers() operation in order to notify observing objects of the change.

    • bindTo

      public void bindTo(AttributeObserver observer)
      Binds this attribute to the specified attribute observer where binding consists of adding the observer to the attribute's set of observers and notifying the observers of a change thereby providing the observer an opportunity to initialize its attribute with this attribute, thereby initializing the "binding".

      This bindTo() operation can be used to create "binding" connectors of attributes in parts or ports to parameters in analysis cases. Specifically, it can be used in SysMLBindingConnectorFunctions to complete the bound connection when invoked by the SysMLBindingConnector.

      Note this method is provided to enable model execution. It is not part of the SysML standard. To the extent the SysML standard does not provide elements for executable modeling per se, SysMLinJava includes various model elements to enable model execution.

      Parameters:
      observer - the observer of this attribute that is to be bound to this attribute
      See Also:
      • SysMLBindingConnector

    • createUnits

      protected abstract void createUnits()
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{
        units = SysMLinJavaUnits.FeetCubic;
}
      See Also:
      • SysMLinJavaUnits

    • createProbabilityDistribution

      protected void createProbabilityDistribution()
      Overridable operation to create the probability distribution of the values of this attribute type. The base class operation specifies an empty or no probability distribution. If a new or different probability distributionAn is desired from the one declared for this base class or for a specific value type, then a subclass will have to be declared that invokes this method to specify the different probability distribution, i.e. each specialization of the SysMLAttributeType should be associated with one and only one type of probability distribution to avoid mixing of distributions. An example of the overridden operation is as follows. 
              @Override
        protected void createProbabilityDistribution()
        {
                probabilityDistribution = Optional.of(new SysMLUniformProbabilityDistribution(0.0, 100.0);
        }
